dataset: Camp Fire 2018 NIST NETTRA Table A-2 road disruption and contraflow candidates
interpretation: Times are NIST's reported or inferred observation times, not verified road-state transition instants. A point locates the source observation and has not been snapped to an OSM segment. An observation window greater than zero means the time is uncertain by that many minutes according to Table A-1. 'reported' denotes a source observation compiled retrospectively by NIST; 'reconstructed' denotes a row whose time source is explicitly Inferred. The announced 09:20 contraflow is not evidence that all three routes were active then.
